info.title: Adamawa LG Online Voting – Simulated Prototype API
info.description: Academic prototype. NOT an official election platform. All responses use the Envelope shape.

get.summary: Get a CSRF token for state-changing requests

post.summary: Register a simulated voter (starts as pending)
Sign in (may require an OTP step)
Sign out and revoke the server-side session
Re-send the one-time code for a pending sign-in
Complete sign-in with the one-time code

get.summary: List polling units in a ward
Elections relevant to the signed-in voter
Has the voter voted? (never the choice)

post.summary: Check that a receipt exists in the ballot box

get.summary: List voters by filter (status, lga_id, ward_id, page)

post.summary: Text search (name, exact email, exact voter ID) in the request body

patch.summary: Verify / reject / suspend / reactivate a voter

post.summary: Publish (optionally at a time) or hide results

get.summary: Audit log (event_type, actor_user_id, entity_type, from, to, page)
